newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia Jan-Sep zinc exports up 4.3 pct to 89,250 T.
newsitem.headline: Russia Jan-Sep zinc exports up 4.3 pct to 89,250 T.

text.p: Russia increased its zinc exports to 89,250 tonnes over January-September, a 4.3 percent rise on year-ago levels, Interfax news agency said on Tuesday, quoting State Customs Committee officials.

The officials said Russia exported 7,530 tonnes of the metal in September, down 16.6 percent from August levels. Primary zinc represented most of the exports in September, and totalled 7,340 tonnes. The rest was of articles made of zinc.
Sweden and the Netherlands were the biggest importers of Russian primary zinc in September, with 3,960 tonnes and 2,970 tonnes, respectively.
The average price of a tonne of Russian zinc in September was $1,004, up from $970 in August.
